text:
maya: Quick Q — embeddings endpoint returning empty results is inconsistent across clients. Some clients get "data": null, others get "data": []. Breaks SDK deserialization. Anyone seen this?
jon: I noticed this after yesterday's canary. On my end when there are no matches we return {"data": []}. Which client is hitting null?
sahil: ruby-sdk hits null when model returns no vectors, JavaScript SDK expects array and throws. We need a stable contract.
leah: agreed — prefer empty array over null for list fields. Null implies absent semantics.
maya: ok consensus leaning empty array. Are we allowed to change behavior on hosted without a major? Backcompat concerns.
jon: small compat risk: old clients that check for null will still work (null vs []). But ones that assume array will break if null is returned. More clients assume array. So moving to array is safer.
api-lint-bot: lint report — embeddings response schema currently declares "data" as (array|null).
maya: can we tighten the schema to array only?
sahil: If we change schema, server should coerce null -> [] at serialization boundary. We can add a compatibility flag for Dedicated/Private; default to new behavior on hosted after X date.
jon: plan: 1) update runtime to always serialize empty array, 2) update JSON Schema in docs to "type": "array", 3) add migration note in changelog and SDKs.
leah: can we also ensure content-type header set to application/json and not rely on implicit? Some old clients parse differently when content-type missing.
maya: yes, let's enforce application/json; charset=utf-8 optional.
sahil: quick patch idea: in serializer: if field is null and field path matches /data/ then write [] — will cover embeddings and rerankers.
maya: PR incoming from @sahil?
sahil: I'll open draft PR and ping reviewers, will include unit test and an integration canary flag.
jon: reviewers: @leah + @maya. Add an api-lint update too.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for embeddings serializer fix on region us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z :eyes: 
maya: ack. Also update sdk breaking notes and add a snippet in docs showing example responses: ```json
{"data": [] , "model": "...", "usage": {"tokens":0}}
```
leah: thanks. small QA request: run jsonschema validator across samples to make sure no nullable slips.
api-lint-bot: ran validation on 200 sample responses, 5 had null data — two from dedicated tenants with legacy flag still on.
sahil: will add migration script and config docs.
maya: timeline?
sahil: aim to merge this week, canary next Friday, full rollout two weeks later if no regressions.
jon: I'll add an automated test in sdk CI that rejects null data.
leah: sounds good. Anything else?
maya: nope, I'll update the product docs and the changelog. Thanks :thumbsup:
